tiling_principles.name: One motif, six relations
tiling_principles.description: Six deterministic black and white fields: translation, alternation, quarter turns, reflection, shifted rows and one local exception. Floor and wall installations share exactly the same generator.
tiling_principles.qfep_connection: A repeated rule makes an address, a field or an environment; the receiver and body determine what can be encountered.

wall_exception.name: The wall turns
wall_exception.description: A thin hinged section of Tutorial_Tiling_Walls and a guarded landing beyond the museum skin. Its inner image shares ONE EXCEPTION; TURN WALL changes passage without changing the pattern. Requires the museum.turning_wall declaration and two floor cells on the east boundary.
interactions: TURN WALL opens or closes the moving panel.
Return inside and step clear before turning; the occupied landing holds the wall.
TURN MOTIF and EXCEPTION on the existing tiling desk also update the hinged surface.
wall_exception.qfep_connection: A local exception in a repeated image differs from an exception in the enclosure: the receiver and its collision decide whether the body can pass.
